Job Overview

We are looking for a curious and hands-on AI Engineer to build, deploy, and operate AI solutions for enterprise customers in regulated industries. In this role, you will build AI agents and LLM-powered applications, connect them to enterprise data and systems, and take them from prototype to production on on-premise infrastructure.

The ideal candidate is a pragmatic engineer with strong applied AI skills who enjoys solving real business problems. You should be comfortable understanding a problem, designing an agent-based or LLM-driven solution, and deploying it to run reliably in production.

Key Responsibilities

  • Problem Understanding: Understand business problems, clarify requirements and success criteria, and propose a practical AI-driven approach.

  • Agent Development: Build and configure AI agents capable of multi-step reasoning, planning and tool use, using agent harnesses and frameworks.

  • Tools & MCP Integration: Build custom tools, skills and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers that let agents interact with APIs, databases and internal systems.

  • Applied AI & RAG: Build LLM-powered applications and RAG pipelines. Optimise prompts, retrieval and context to improve the accuracy and reliability of outputs.

  • Evaluation & Optimisation: Test and evaluate agent and LLM outputs, then improve accuracy, latency and cost across models and workflows.

  • Deployment & Operations: Deploy and operate models and AI services on on-premise infrastructure using Linux, Docker and Kubernetes. Monitor performance, troubleshoot issues and keep services reliable.

  • Data Integration: Connect data sources, build data pipelines, and prepare data for retrieval, analytics and AI use cases.

  • Delivery Ownership: Own assigned workstreams from proof-of-concept to production: plan tasks, manage timelines and flag risks early.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, AI, IT or a related field. (Fresh graduates to 3 years of experience; high-potential fresh graduates are welcome.)

  • Applied AI: Hands-on experience building with LLMs through final year projects, internships, side projects or hackathons, with a working understanding of prompt engineering, tool/function calling, RAG and AI agents.

  • Programming: Proficiency in at least one programming language such as Python, Go or TypeScript (Node.js), with Git for version control.

  • Linux & Containers: Solid working knowledge of Linux environments (CLI) and hands-on experience containerising and running applications with Docker.

  • Ownership: Takes ownership of problems end to end, from understanding the need to delivering a working result, and thrives in a fast-paced environment.

  • Language: Proficient in written and spoken English.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Production AI Delivery: Experience delivering production-ready AI projects across the full software development life cycle (SDLC), from design and development through testing and deployment.

  • Agent Frameworks & MCP: Experience with agent frameworks such as LangGraph, and building MCP servers.

  • RAG Pipelines: Familiarity with document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector databases and rerankers.

  • Model Serving: Experience with vLLM, Ollama or similar model-serving tools.

  • Orchestration: Exposure to Kubernetes or deployments in on-premise / private cloud environments.

  • Data: SQL skills and experience building data pipelines.

  • Stakeholder Communication: Able to explain technical work clearly to non-technical stakeholders, present demos and gather requirements.

SleekFlow is an AI Suite for Revenue-Driving Conversations. We are trusted by over 2,000 enterprises globally. But we are more than just a SaaS company; we are an AI-native movement redefining the B2C relationship across 70+ countries.

From first-click conversion to long-term retention, we turn every conversation into a data-backed growth opportunity. Headquartered in Singapore with a global presence in Hong Kong, the UAE, and the US, we are looking for exceptional people to help us build an AI operating system that matters.


Join us and rewrite how the world engages at scale.


Learn more from our blogs for developers: https://sleekflow.io/blog/category/developer-blog


Mid-Level

Location: Malaysia

Minimum Experience: 1~2 years of experience working with RAG/LLM development and deployment

Language: Fluency in English is required


Role

We are seeking a highly skilled LLM/RAG/Multi-Agent Infrastructure Engineer to design, develop, and optimize infrastructure for integrating Large Language Models (LLMs) via APIs, building efficient Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems, and enabling multi-agent frameworks. You will work at the intersection of AI applications, knowledge retrieval, and automation to create high-performance, scalable solutions that power next-generation AI-driven applications.


Key Responsibilities

  • LLM Evaluation: Assess the strengths and limitations of various LLMs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, Cohere) to determine the best fit for specific applications and use cases.
  • RAG Pipeline Engineering: Develop and scale RAG architectures, integrating vector databases, retrieval mechanisms, and embedding models for efficient knowledge retrieval.
  • Multi-Agent Coordination: Design robust infrastructure to support multi-agent interactions, enabling efficient message passing, distributed decision-making, and autonomous collaboration.
  • Knowledge Base Development: Design and implement structured knowledge bases that enhance LLM output quality by integrating domain-specific data, ontologies, and automated document indexing.
  • Databases & Storage: Use vector databases, NoSQL databases, and caching mechanisms (e.g., Redis, PostgreSQL, ElasticSearch) to support efficient knowledge retrieval and AI workloads.
  • Observability & Monitoring: Establish logging, monitoring, and tracing systems for API performance, system health, and anomaly detection.
  • Security & Compliance: Ensure best practices for data privacy, security, and compliance in AI deployments.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with AI researchers, ML engineers, and software developers to integrate AI models into production environments effectively.


Required Qualifications

  • Experience with LLM APIs & RAG: Hands-on experience in integrating LLM APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, Cohere) and building RAG pipelines with vector search (e.g., FAISS, Weaviate, Pinecone).
  • Multi-Agent Frameworks: Familiarity with multi-agent systems (e.g., LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI) and their infrastructure requirements.
  • Knowledge Base Engineering: Experience in designing, indexing, and maintaining structured and unstructured knowledge bases, including knowledge graph construction, ontology design, and text embedding techniques.
  • CI/CD & MLOps: Experience with ML model versioning, deployment pipelines, and monitoring tools.
  • Prompt Engineering Expertise: Proficiency in designing clear, structured prompts, optimizing AI responses through iterative refinement, and leveraging advanced techniques like few-shot learning and chain-of-thought reasoning for improved accuracy and coherence.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience in AI infrastructure for high-traffic SaaS or enterprise AI applications.
  • Knowledge of reinforcement learning and agent-based AI systems.
  • Experience with real-time streaming architectures (Kafka, Ray, or similar).
  • Experience in leveraging structured and semi-structured data for improving LLM-generated outputs.


Our Culture Code

  • Open-mindedness – We welcome different viewpoints and give and take feedback openly, always ready to challenge our own assumptions.
  • Collaboration – We have each other's back, share knowledge freely, and treat every teammate with equal respect.
  • Growth – We pursue continuous improvement, embrace new challenges, and treat mistakes as chances to learn.
  • Ownership – We take initiative, see things through, and hold ourselves accountable for the outcome.
  • Grit & Adaptability – We stay resilient through setbacks and adapt to change with patience and persistence.

  • Attractive compensation package, including a 13th-month salary.
  • Stock options in a rapidly growing startup.
  • A fun, diverse, and international team culture.
  • Comprehensive group medical insurance.

  • Flexible work-from-home policy.
  • “Work From Anywhere” scheme.
  • Rewarding continuous learning from experienced team leads.
  • Many more exciting perks and growth opportunities!

C. AI untuk Operasi Pembinaan dan Pengurusan Projek

  1. Meneroka penggunaan AI dalam proses pembinaan rumah dan pengurusan projek ZASMA.

  2. Membangunkan penyelesaian AI untuk membantu semakan dokumen teknikal, lukisan, spesifikasi dan laporan projek.

  1. Membantu menganalisis data projek bagi mengenal pasti risiko kelewatan, pembaziran kos dan isu kualiti.

D. Data Analytics dan Business Intelligence

  2. Membangunkan dashboard dan sistem pelaporan pintar untuk pihak pengurusan.

  3. Menggunakan data bagi mengenal pasti trend, corak prestasi dan peluang penambahbaikan.

  4. Menghasilkan analisis ramalan (predictive analytics) bagi membantu proses membuat keputusan.

  5. Memastikan data yang digunakan adalah tepat, relevan dan berkualiti.

E. Integrasi Sistem dan Penyelenggaraan

  1. Mengintegrasikan aplikasi AI dengan sistem dan perisian pihak ketiga melalui API.

  2. Memastikan sistem AI berfungsi dengan baik, stabil dan boleh digunakan oleh pengguna.

  3. Menjalankan troubleshooting, debugging dan penambahbaikan sistem.

  4. Melaksanakan ujian sistem sebelum sesuatu penyelesaian AI digunakan secara rasmi.

  5. Menyediakan dokumentasi teknikal, panduan penggunaan dan rekod penyelenggaraan.

F. Penyelidikan dan Inovasi Teknologi

  1. Mengikuti perkembangan teknologi terkini dalam bidang AI, Machine Learning dan Generative AI.

  2. Menilai kesesuaian teknologi AI baharu untuk diaplikasikan dalam operasi syarikat.

  4. Mencadangkan inovasi digital yang boleh memberikan kelebihan daya saing kepada ZASMA.

  5. Membandingkan keberkesanan teknologi dan platform AI dari aspek kos, fungsi, keselamatan dan pulangan pelaburan.

G. Keselamatan dan Tadbir Urus AI

  1. Memastikan penggunaan AI mematuhi polisi keselamatan maklumat dan kerahsiaan syarikat.

  2. Mengawal akses kepada data dan sistem yang digunakan dalam pembangunan AI.

  3. Memastikan penyelesaian AI tidak mendedahkan maklumat sulit syarikat atau pelanggan.

  5. Memastikan setiap penyelesaian AI mempunyai kawalan manusia (human oversight) bagi keputusan yang kritikal.

3. Pembangunan dan Kerjasama Antara Jabatan

  1. Bekerjasama dengan semua Ketua Jabatan dan Ketua Unit untuk mengenal pasti keperluan AI mengikut fungsi jabatan masing-masing.

About Pratham International

Pratham International is a US 501(c)(3) established to support learning innovations for children and youth in contexts across the globe. We enable the adaptation and spread of proven and scalable education solutions pioneered in India by Pratham Education Foundation to contexts across the global south through programming and technical assistance tailored to local realities. Today, Pratham reaches approximately 7.5 million children annually across 23 Indian states and union territories and an additional 1 million across 31 countries..

Through the Pratham Shah PraDigi Innovation Centre (PraDigi), Pratham International also seeks to create technology innovations for low-resource communities, and support models aimed at learning for school, work, and life for children and youth. We work on several cutting-edge projects in the domain of Generative AI, Automatic Speech Recognition, and Natural Language Processing.

The team’s innovative technology products include the Anytime Testing Model (ATM), an AI-enabled question generation and grading system that allows learners to be assessed on any topic, anytime; PadhAI: Reading Assessment App, which uses advanced speech recognition to evaluate children’s reading fluency in Hindi and eight Indian languages; and a suite of LLM-powered chatbots designed for diverse learning contexts: from BaalSakhi for early childhood care, to a skilling interview bot for youth employment readiness, and OCR-based analysis tools that digitize and assess student work at scale.

At Pratham International, we build for the long term. Whether it’s ensuring products are truly accessible across rural India and the global south through languages, building datasets to ensure context and accuracy for products, or gathering feedback from the field. Backed by partners like Google.org, Anthropic, and the Gates Foundation, we are committed to building digital public goods that ensure every child is in school and learning well.

Description of the Role
Pratham International, through its wholly-owned subsidiary in India (PULS Pvt. Ltd.), is looking to hire an AI Engineer for the PraDigi Initiative.

As an ASR Engineer, you will lead the development and deployment of speech recognition systems for automated reading assessment across multiple languages. The engineer will work across the full ASR pipeline: from supervising data collection, annotation, data preparation and model training to decoding, alignment, error analysis, and deployment. This is a hands-on role at the intersection of speech recognition, multilingual NLP, and educational assessment.

Key responsibilities include:

Data Collection and Annotation

  • Provide technical inputs to speech data collection design, including sampling across languages, dialects, age groups, reading levels, recording environments, devices, and target items to ensure the dataset is representative and useful for model training and evaluation.
  • Define annotation guidelines and quality checks for transcripts, reading errors, disfluencies, background speech and other phenomena relevant to reading assessment.
  • Work with data and field teams to identify data gaps and annotation inconsistencies through model error analysis, and recommend targeted additional data collection or re-annotation where needed.
  • Help design annotation schemas and inter-annotator quality processes so labels are consistent enough for model training, alignment, and evaluation.

Model Training

  • Train, fine-tune, and evaluate ASR models for children’s read speech across multiple languages and accents.
  • Build pipelines for audio preprocessing, segmentation, normalization, transcription alignment, and model training.
  • Adapt existing ASR architectures such as Whisper, wav2vec 2.0, Conformer, CTC/RNN-T, or similar models for reading assessment.
  • Optimize models for practical deployment environments, including low-bandwidth, store-and-forward, server-based, and potentially offline/mobile inference.

Adopting for Reading Assessment

  • Develop approaches for accurately detecting substitutions, omissions, insertions, repetitions, partial-word attempts, hesitations and self-corrections. Implement forced alignment, phoneme-level alignment, or pronunciation-scoring approaches where required.
  • Conduct systematic error analysis by language, reading level, age, accent, gender, recording conditions, and device.
  • Collaborate with assessment experts and field teams to translate model outputs into measures such as reading accuracy, WCPM, fluency, and reading level.

Benchmarking

  • Define and track ASR metrics relevant to reading assessment, including WER/CER, word-level accuracy, error-detection precision/recall, alignment accuracy, and reading-score agreement with human evaluators.
  • Build reproducible experimentation and model-evaluation pipelines and maintain clear technical documentation.

Desired Experience and Qualification

We are looking for an AI/ML Engineer with ASR expertise that can own the ASR based reading assessment pipeline across multiple languages

  • A Degree in any Mathematics/Computer Science/Data Science or related STEM field
  • 3-5 years of full-time experience; at least 2 working in an AI/ML role
  • Strong experience in automatic speech recognition, speech processing, or spoken-language technologies.
  • Strong Python skills and experience with PyTorch or similar deep-learning frameworks.
  • Experience working with modern ASR architectures and toolkits such as Hugging Face Transformers, NeMo, Kaldi, or equivalent.
  • Understanding of ASR concepts including:
    -acoustic modelling
    -CTC / transducer / encoder-decoder architectures
    -decoding and beam search
    -language models
    -forced alignment
    -phoneme representations
    -WER/CER and ASR error analysis
  • Experience preparing and working with large-scale audio and transcription datasets.
  • Ability to diagnose model errors systematically rather than relying only on aggregate transcription accuracy.

Why join us?

You take the models and LLM products our data scientists design and run them in production. Apply by doing a short take-home first; the steps are at the end of this post.

Link to the assessment: https://github.com/OneCreditMY/mle-take-home


The Company

OneCredit is Malaysia's newest credit bureau, registered under the Ministry of Finance. We turn credit and business data into insights that help businesses and consumers manage risk and make informed decisions.


The Role

The work spans classic ML and LLM agents, from training and evaluation to running them in production. You'll work with data scientists and product managers: shipping models as APIs and batch jobs, watching them in production, and building LLM agents. Small team, real production systems, ownership from day one.


What You'll Do

  • Package ML models and LLM services as APIs, batch and streaming jobs, and ship them to AWS
  • Build CI/CD, model versioning and reproducible pipelines
  • Watch latency, errors, drift, cost and output quality, and fix what breaks
  • Build LLM agents with retrieval, tool calling and guardrails
  • Set up tracing and evaluation, so we know when a change made things better
  • Leave templates behind that make the next deployment faster


What We're Looking For

  • 0 to 2 years building software, ML or data systems. Fresh graduates with real projects are very welcome
  • Solid Python and SQL
  • Experience building APIs (we use FastAPI), and comfortable with Docker, Git, CI/CD and a cloud provider (AWS preferred)
  • Working ML knowledge: training, evaluation, and why a model that scores well offline can still fail in production
  • Some hands-on LLM work beyond a prompt, such as an agent, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), or an LLM service with evaluation. Depth is a plus
  • Plus: fintech or regulated-industry experience


Tech Stack

Python, FastAPI, Go, Rust, Apache Airflow, RabbitMQ, Snowflake, AWS, MLflow, Modal, GitHub Actions, Terraform, Datadog, Langfuse.


Why OneCredit?

  • Run ML and AI systems on real, high-stakes financial data
  • Classic ML and LLM agents in the same team
  • Ownership from day one, with people who will help you grow
  • Early team, fast progression for high performers

Kuala Lumpur, 3 days in office.


Interview Process

  • Take-home → HR screen → technical interview (a walkthrough of your take-home) → team interview → CEO
  • To apply: do the take-home at https://github.com/OneCreditMY/mle-take-home (4 to 6 hours), then send it with your résumé through the form linked in its README.
  • Everyone who submits gets written feedback by email.

About the role

AI Development Engineer (MCP & Agent Direction) is responsible for engineering generative AI capabilities into film and animation production workflows, with focus on MCP toolchain construction, agent workflow orchestration, stylized rendering generation pipelines, and model distillation & compression. The role requires complete practical experience in generative models from training, evaluation to local deployment, capable of completing model compression, inference optimization and effect evaluation loops under local compute conditions, ensuring generation results are controllable, reproducible and accountable.

Key responsibilities

  • MCP server planning, development and governance: encapsulate image generation, video generation, asset retrieval, ComfyUI workflow execution, rendering data export capabilities as standard MCP tool interfaces; implement parameter specifications, permission control, cost marking and audit logs; align with MCP stateless specifications, support capability discovery, self-contained requests and standardized error handling; design MCP service interfaces for DCC integration

  • Agent workflow orchestration and implementation: support multi-step task decomposition and execution in film and animation production scenarios, support long task asynchronous execution, breakpoint continuation, failure retry and manual confirmation; implement Orchestrator-Worker, Fan-out/Fan-in, tool calling, structured output, RAG retrieval enhancement capabilities; establish evaluation metrics for agent success rate, manual intervention rate, retry rate, generation consistency and single-shot cost

  • Stylized rendering generation pipeline construction: manage style model training, evaluation and version management (LoRA / Style Pack / IP-Adapter); apply structural constraints (ControlNet, depth maps, normal maps, edge maps, reference image conditions); maintain character ID consistency and inter-shot style consistency; output layered data for AI neural rendering including depth, normal, Alpha, optical flow, camera trajectory, skeleton metadata

  • Model distillation, compression and inference acceleration: design distillation schemes for image, video and multimodal generation models including teacher/student model training, step distillation, training data construction and effect evaluation; complete quantization and inference acceleration engineering covering FP8, INT4, NVFP4, GGUF, ONNX, TensorRT, vLLM solutions; establish automated evaluation system covering FID/CLIP Score, prompt adherence, temporal stability, artifact rate and single-shot generation cost

  • Local inference service deployment and resource management: containerized deployment, interface encapsulation, multi-tenant isolation, GPU memory quota management, task queue and priority scheduling; establish cost accounting mechanisms for single image, single shot, per-second video generation; monitor service health, queue congestion, failure modes and regeneration trigger conditions

  • Third-party AI model API integration and orchestration: evaluate, integrate and orchestrate multiple third-party AI model APIs (image generation, video generation, 3D model generation, PBR material generation); design API routing strategies, load balancing and degradation schemes ensuring stability and timeliness in multi-model parallel calls

  • DCC software AI client integration: embed AI generation capabilities as plugins in DCC tools (Blender/Maya) enabling artists to call AI capabilities directly in software viewport; design and implement DCC plugin AI function modules including in-viewport AI generation preview, parameter adjustment panels, asynchronous task status monitoring; ensure AI operations integrate seamlessly with artist workflows

  • AI generated content quality evaluation system construction: establish automated quality evaluation pipeline for AI generated content including 3D model topology quality scoring, inter-frame consistency detection for video, material seamlessness checking, image style consistency assessment; establish quality gate standards ensuring AI output meets production archival threshold

  • Agent tool registry and capability discovery mechanism: design and manage MCP tool registry supporting tool version management, capability discovery, dependency declaration and compatibility verification; implement MCP Server capability declaration and auto-discovery protocol enabling AI Agent to dynamically perceive available tools and autonomously orchestrate calling chains

  • Multimodal generation pipeline design: design cross-modal AI generation pipelines (image→video→3D→material) involving format conversion between different models, condition data transmission, style consistency maintenance; design pipeline-level error handling, retry mechanisms and manual review nodes ensuring end-to-end reliability

  • Generation result reproducibility, version management and regression testing: implement model version locking, random seed recording, parameter snapshots, workflow JSON archiving and rendering manifest generation; establish regression testing mechanisms for style packs, distilled models, MCP tools and agent workflows; support version rollback and issue closure when quality, latency or cost baselines regress

  • Technology tracking and production introduction assessment: track technology progress in generative video, stylized rendering, MCP/Agent frameworks, local inference optimization; organize PoC verification and selection evaluation from quality, stability, license compliance and production adaptation dimensions providing actionable introduction recommendations

About you

  • Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Automation, Computer Graphics or related field

  • 3+ years Python engineering development experience with service-oriented and containerized deployment practice

  • 1+ year generative model engineering experience covering at least two directions among training, evaluation, quantization, distillation or inference optimization

  • Strong English technical literature reading ability and technical documentation writing ability

  • Familiar with mainstream generative model training and inference processes including Stable Diffusion, FLUX / FLUX.2 Klein, Qwen-Image, AnimateDiff, LTX-2, Minimax H3 or equivalent diffusion/flow matching models

  • Deep hands-on experience with ComfyUI and/or Diffusers capable of completing workflow automation execution, custom node integration, model/VAE/LoRA management, batch scheduling and VRAM optimization

  • Master model compression and inference acceleration methods, familiar with at least two of: knowledge distillation, step distillation, FP8/INT4/NVFP4 quantization, LoRA merging, TensorRT, vLLM, GGUF/ONNX export or inference acceleration frameworks

  • Familiar with style fine-tuning training process (LoRA / Style Pack) capable of independently completing data construction, overfitting discrimination, style consistency evaluation and online closure

  • Large language model application development experience, familiar with tool calling, structured output, RAG retrieval enhancement, Function Calling, MCP tool registration and agent evaluation

  • Engineering judgment capability able to reasonably divide boundaries between model capabilities and rule logic, accurately attribute generation, inference and pipeline failures

  • Third-party AI model API integration and orchestration experience with actual engineering experience integrating multiple external AI generation APIs (image/video/3D generation), capable of implementing API routing design, load balancing, degradation strategies and circuit breaker mechanisms

Role Overview

Contribute to the R&D of the Agent system for an AI game creation platform. Building on the company's existing game editor and runtime, enable users to create and modify games through natural language. The role focuses on the Agent execution loop, tool integration, art asset automation, and reliability engineering. It does not require training or algorithmic development of underlying generative models. This position starts as an internship, and we strongly welcome applications from current Master's and PhD students.


Responsibilities

  • Contribute to the R&D of the Agent system for the AI game creation platform. Building on the company's existing game editor and runtime, enable users to create and modify games through natural language.
  • Contribute to the development of the Agent execution loop for game creation, including intent understanding, task planning, tool invocation, context and execution-state management, result validation, and error recovery, supporting multi-step task completion over extended interactions.
  • Collaborate with the editor and game R&D teams to encapsulate existing capabilities—such as maps, characters, skills, and gameplay rules—and integrate them into the Agent, supporting flexible configuration and composition.
  • Contribute to the game art asset generation and processing pipeline. By invoking tools or services for image generation, image editing, background removal, motion generation, video frame extraction, and sprite-sheet processing, enable automation from user requirements to usable game assets.
  • Collaborate with the art and asset-system R&D teams to complete resource-generation task orchestration, asynchronous status tracking, result validation, failure retry, and asset ingestion, and apply assets in-game through the editor.
  • Contribute to operational reliability. Handle duplicate requests, execution failures, and related issues; support task recovery, operation tracking, and undo.
  • Build Agent test cases and evaluation processes. Through experiments, log analysis, and failure-case reviews, continuously optimize task success rate, interaction experience, response speed, and invocation cost.


Requirements

  • Master's degree or above in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Automation, Mathematics, or a related field. Current Master's/PhD students and fresh graduates are all welcome.
  • Solid programming and computer-science fundamentals. Proficient in at least one of Python, TypeScript, or Go, with the ability to independently complete module development, debugging, and testing.
  • Hands-on project experience with Agents, from research, internships, open source, or personal projects. Practical involvement in a multi-step task flow—"understanding user requirements, decomposing tasks, invoking tools or APIs, and continuing based on execution results"—with the ability to show code or running results and explain your own contributions, problems encountered, and how they were solved. Project experience should not be limited to Q&A applications or simple model API calls.
  • Understanding of structured output from large models, tool invocation, context management, and task planning; awareness of model capability boundaries; ability to reasonably divide responsibilities between model inference and deterministic program logic.
  • Basic software engineering and system-integration skills. Familiarity with HTTP APIs, databases, asynchronous tasks, and exception handling; ability to integrate existing business capabilities into an Agent.
  • Ability to design experiments and analyze problems: construct test cases, analyze failure causes, and validate optimization effects through controlled experiments.
  • Proactive learning, communication, collaboration, and execution skills. Willingness to deeply understand game-creation scenarios and translate technical solutions into usable product features.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Agent project experience with natural-language-driven editors, AI programming, low-code builders, design tools, or other complex business operations.
  • Project experience with image generation and editing, image processing, video or motion generation, or sprite-sheet processing.
  • Research experience in Agent planning, memory, tool use, or evaluation.
  • AI application R&D internship experience, open-source contributions, or personal projects used by real users.
  • Experience in game development, configuration-driven systems, or automated testing.

Get to Know the Team

In the GrabMart Data Science team, you are at the heart of Grab's retail and grocery engine. We build and deploy AI/ML models that power seamless shopping experiences across our ecosystem. Our mission is to transform how millions shop. We achieve this by solving complex challenges in inventory intelligence, demand forecasting, and hyper-personalized discovery. Our goal is to ensure every user finds exactly what they need, right when they need it.

You will report to our Senior Data Science Manager and based onsite in our office in Petaling Jaya, Selangor.

Get to Know the Role

We are looking for Senior Machine Learning Engineers to lead high impact technical workstreams within our shopping ecosystem. You will manage technical projects from brainstorming to production—developing scalable DS architectures, deploying services, and ensuring model robustness. You will work as a technical expert, collaborating with Engineering, Product, and Analytics to provide advanced, data-driven solutions.

The Critical Tasks You Will Perform

  • Extract Insights: You will analyze massive datasets (transactional, behavioral, and geospatial) to decode shopping patterns and improve the end-to-end journey for grocery and retail services.
  • Develop AI Solutions:
    • Next-Gen User Experience: You will move beyond static interfaces to build agentic, conversational, and anticipatory experiences. You will predict shopping intent and brand preferences to power autonomous shopping assistants that can handle complex queries, automate re-ordering, and provide hyper-personalized discovery.
    • Service Reliability: You will build predictive models to safeguard the order lifecycle by identifying high-risk orders prone to cancellation, predicting fulfillment failures due to insufficient inventory, and flagging transactions requiring proactive intervention.
    • Demand Forecasting: You will create high precision, hyper-local spatio-temporal models using complex signals (weather, events, marketing). You will provide granular SKU-level predictions to improve supply chain readiness and minimize waste.
    • Demand Shaping: You will implement intelligent optimization algorithms to balance demand and supply in real-time. You will improve platform visibility and use contextual nudges spatially and temporally to balance demand with merchant/driver supply
    • Demand Generation: You will decode unique user shopping patterns to unlock new demand. You will build AI models for automated targeting and user segmentation to drive sustainable growth.

You will adopt ML Operational Excellence practices to ensure vigorous versioning, automated testing, seamless deployment, performance monitoring, and continuous improvement of ML pipelines.

  • Collaborate cross functionally: You will partner with Project Managers, Engineers, and Operations to integrate and scale solutions across the region.
